dct_description_sm: This phase (one) of the One Voice project has focused on identifying and analyzing the existing sources of documented and available Traditional Knowledge and Inuit 'Qaujimajatuqangit' related to the watershed of Baker Lake including that pertaining to water quantity, quality and flow, fish species and fishing livelihoods and other aquatic life.
dct_subject_sm: Health sciences and contaminants -> Water quality
dct_title_s: One Voice, Methods Development on Inuit Qaujimajatuqangit Data Collection (NGMP ID LU11)
